stories.title: Munich conference ends with Europe looking for a future less dependent on the U.S.
stories.summary: As the Munich Security Conference wraps up, reassurances from Marco Rubio met a Europe questioning whether it can — and must — stand on its own.

stories.title: Landmark tech trials on social media addiction seen through a mother's eyes
stories.summary: With multiple tech addiction trials expected this year, Julianna Arnold of the parents group 'Parents Rise' says the legal pressure is overdue for Big Tech.

stories.title: Chef's soup dumpling lesson doubles as a love letter to DC's Chinatown
stories.summary: Chef Tim Ma, owner of Lucky Danger in Washington's Chinatown, walks us through how to fold soup dumplings in preparation for Lunar New Year celebrations.

stories.title: The rising cost of online betting addiction among young people
stories.summary: In an era when you can bet on almost any sporting event on your phone, it is no surprise that gambling addiction is on the rise. Young men are particularly likely to get in too deep. WBUR's Patrick Madden reports from Massachusetts.

stories.title: 'Pillion' drops a timid singer into a gay biker BDSM world
stories.summary: A24's new film Pillion follows a timid singer pulled into a biker's BDSM relationship. Alexander Skarsgård talks about his enigmatic character in the movie.

stories.title: Bangladesh's first fair vote in years comes with a daunting to-do list
stories.summary: A landmark election in Bangladesh ended years of disputed polls, and now the winners face pressure to tackle corruption and a battered economy.
